This run touches ONLY docs/issues/, lib/letflow/design/, docs/migration/decisions/, and handoffs/ -- no lib/letflow/ implementation code, no priv/repo/migrations/, no web/. Despite that, this run is NOT exempt from the git wrapper the way WF-01 is: WF-01's exemption applies only to docs/requirements.yaml-only runs; this run also writes a genuine design-exploration artefact and decision record, which is exactly the same file-shape CODE-DESIGNER/CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR/REVIEWER already gated it through, so route it through the full GIT_MERGE procedure rather than a shortcut.

Per this project's OWN new rule (added today, ISS-0467/PR #902): under NO circumstances push directly to main, even for a doc-only or one-file change -- always feature branch -> PR -> gh pr merge. You already know this; it is restated here because this run's own diff is unusually small and that is exactly the shape ISS-0467 was filed against.

Use --title "docs: ISS-0439 1C-taxonomy design exploration, deferral recorded as decision 0019 [WF03-ISS0439-20260904]" for the PR (WF-03 branches use the "fix"/"docs" prefix matching the actual change shape; this is a docs change, not a fix, so "docs:" is the more accurate prefix -- use your judgement per GIT_MERGE.md step 7's own title guidance if you disagree, but state why in your result if you deviate).
